title: Lombard Odier亚洲CIO：新兴市场更看好韩国、台湾和巴西，利差交易有利
speaker: John Woods

segments.en: So we talked about EM equities. This is a little massively an EM equity played. Have we missed out on any opportunities? I mean AI is obviously crowded out mind space completely almost. Well I mean the EM story for us is more a function of South Korea.
segments.zh: 我们谈到了新兴市场权益资产。这是新兴市场权益资产的表现。我们错过了什么机会吗？人工智能显然几乎占据了所有注意力。对我们来说，新兴市场的故事更多是关于韩国。

segments.en: It's Taiwan to an extent its South Korea and Brazil on value. That's how the preferred country status is being communicated. I mean it's one about valuations, it's one about underlying macro growth.
segments.zh: 一定程度上是台湾，还有韩国和巴西，基于价值。这就是优选国家的逻辑。这关乎估值，也关乎潜在宏观增长。

segments.en: The likelihood that certain central banks will remain on hold higher for longer meaning it's supportive of a carry trade from a currency perspective. Rather than the low yielders. So overall this play has outperformed developed markets yet to date and it's one that we will hold over into the second half of the year as well.
segments.zh: 某些央行可能更长时间维持高利率，这对货币利差交易有利，而不是低收益货币。总体而言，这一策略今年迄今跑赢发达市场，我们将在下半年继续持有。

segments.en: Is that carry trade still the end? That's the most favorable play. Well there's a number of candidates. There's that well in the Swiss brackets obviously a classic example as well. So is the Hong Kong dollar on a relative basis with the US and of course the yen as well.
segments.zh: 利差交易仍然是最有利的策略吗？有很多候选。瑞士法郎显然是一个经典例子。港币相对于美元也是，当然还有日元。

segments.en: And even more so given options pricing suggesting that it's likely to tick a little higher. But yeah the overall carry trade I think favors these higher yielding currencies. And predominantly they tend to sit in the emerging market complex.
segments.zh: 期权定价显示这些货币可能进一步走高。总体而言，利差交易有利于这些高收益货币，而它们主要存在于新兴市场。
